topics.name: Test Suite Identity
topics.purpose: Define coherent collections of exact test cases with declared target scope, ordering/dependency policy and pass criteria.

semantics.identity_rule: Each suite has an explicit identity/version.
semantics.member_rule: Suite members are exact test case refs.
semantics.order_rule: Execution order is explicit only where semantically required.
semantics.authority_rule: Suite membership does not change test or target ownership.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: file order determines dependent test order
one passing test masks failures without threshold policy
